subject: POC onboarding: environment handoff & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Bonnet <ryan.bonnet@corticare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC onboarding: environment handoff & acceptance checklist

Hi Ryan / Elena,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get the Corticare POC into a production-like environment. I put together a short handoff checklist below that we can fold into the MAP and use as the acceptance criteria for the evaluation window. Please confirm the items you own vs. what you want Redwood to provision.

Summary checklist (POC environment):
- Org setup: create a tenant/project for the POC (name suggestion: cortic-poc). We need an admin contact + service account to integrate with Redwood console.
- API keys: Redwood will accept an API key from your tenant or we can issue a scoped key. If you want to self-host keys we need the service account email and IAM roles.
- IP allowlist: provide the CIDR(s) to add to your firewall; Redwood will provide egress IPs.
- VPC peering: if you prefer private connectivity, confirm AWS account id and VPC id; otherwise we can use secure public endpoints.

Proposed milestones (target close timeline):
- By 2026-08-20: Org created and service account assigned (your action)
- By 2026-08-24: API key or key integration validated + basic network allowlist configured (joint)
- By 2026-08-27: VPC peering completed (if chosen) and smoke tests passed (Redwood runs tests)
- By 2026-08-31: POC acceptance window opens (1 week) and success criteria measurement starts

Attachments: I will upload a draft MAP that includes the acceptance checklist and a lightweight network diagram.

Quick asks for you now:
1) Confirm whether you want Redwood to create the scoped API key (we issue and rotate) or whether you will create a key in your tenant.
2) If you want VPC peering, reply with AWS account id, VPC id, and a preferred maintenance window (e.g., 8/25 22:00-00:00 UTC).
3) Provide any IP ranges that must be allowed (or we can share our outbound IP set).

Thanks — I put Marissa and Neha on the thread to help with contractual/timing and infra questions.

Best,
Priyom
CTO, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (stub) MAP-v1.1.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Ryan Bonnet <ryan.bonnet@corticare.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@corticare.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: environment handoff & acceptance checklist

Thanks Priyom — this looks good and is appreciated. A couple of clarifying questions from our infra/ security folks: 

1) VPC peering: We prefer peering for the pilot. Our AWS account id is 712345678901 and VPC id is vpc-0a1b2c3d. Can Redwood initiate the peering request or do we need to open a ticket? Also, do you support cross-account route propagation with a NAT gateway (we typically avoid exposing services on the internet).

2) IP allowlist: We have a strict outbound firewall. Can you provide a short list of the specific egress IPs (not a /16) for the POC so we can whitelist them?

3) API keys: For security, we prefer to generate keys on our side and hand them to Redwood. If that's the route, what specific IAM permissions does the service account need?

One more practical ask — can you confirm the minimum throughput you expect (RPS) for the smoke tests so we can provision test capacity on our side?

We can hit your proposed milestones but will need the IPs and IAM scope to start.

—Ryan
Director Infrastructure, Corticare
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Bonnet <ryan.bonnet@corticare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: environment handoff & acceptance checklist

Thanks Ryan — answers inline and next steps below.

1) VPC peering: Redwood can initiate the peering request from our account side once you confirm the VPC ID. For the peer request we need: your AWS account id (712345678901), your VPC id (vpc-0a1b2c3d), CIDR of the peer VPC, and a single point-of-contact who can accept the request in AWS Console. Maintenance window of 8/25 22:00-00:00 UTC works for us.

2) IP allowlist: For customers who prefer public endpoints we provide a short set of stable egress IPs for the POC. For this engagement, please add the following to your allowlist (TCP ports 443):
- 34.103.21.45/32
- 34.103.21.46/32
- 34.103.21.47/32
(We'll provide a signed attestation that these are our egress addresses in the MAP doc.)

Note: if you complete VPC peering we can skip the public allowlist and remove these IPs.

3) API keys / IAM scope: If Corticare generates the key, create a service account named redwood-poc-service@corticare-prod. Grant the following minimal perms: 
- IAM: iam.serviceAccounts.get (read)
- Cloud Resource Manager: resourcemanager.projects.get
- (If you prefer scoped keys via Redwood, we can issue and rotate a scoped key for the duration of the pilot.)

4) Throughput for smoke tests: plan for 20 rps sustained, bursts to 50 rps for 1 minute. That is modest and intended to validate latency and throughput SLAs. If you want a heavier load we can adjust.

I've attached the one-page MAP with a checklist and the lightweight network diagram. Action items I will take from here: finalize the MAP, create the HubSpot milestone (HubSpot:HS-349128) and set a target close date of 2026-08-31.

Action items (owners):
- Corticare: create service account, add outbound allowlist OR accept peering request — target 2026-08-20 (owner: Ryan)
- Redwood (Priyom/Neha): share final MAP and scheduled peering request once credentials available — target 2026-08-22
- Joint: run smoke tests and share results — target 2026-08-27

Attachment: (stub) MAP-v1.1.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
Attachment: (stub) network-diagram.png (png, 95KB)

If that works I will submit the peering request on 8/22 and follow up with operations to accept it in your account.

Best,
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Bonnet <ryan.bonnet@corticare.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: environment handoff & acceptance checklist

Hi Ryan — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming the account/VPC ids. Two quick items from the commercial/ops side before we kick off: 

1) Trial credits & pricing: we'll provision a $5k trial credit for the POC and price the pilot at our standard dev tier. If the POC moves to dedicated capacity we can discuss a short-term uplift in the contract.

2) Acceptance criteria: we'll use the MAP (attached) as the single source of truth. Per Priyom's timeline, target close date Aug 31 is fine from my side. Please confirm any blackout dates for your SRE team.

Next steps (short):
- Ryan: confirm you will accept the peering request on 8/22 (or confirm alternate window).
- Ryan: confirm the allowlist entries above if you will not use peering.
- Priyom/Neha: submit peering request and share request id + HubSpot milestone when created.

Happy to set a 30-min checkpoint on Friday if helpful to drive acceptance.

Cheers,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
